scenarios.title: The opening offer owns the range
scenarios.prompt: A supplier opens at €120 per unit. The buying team immediately discusses whether €105 would be a good deal, although no independent range was prepared.
scenarios.question: What should the team establish before responding?

options.text: An evidence-based range, reservation point and alternatives independent of the opening offer.
A percentage discount that looks substantial against €120.
How confident the supplier sounded when naming the price.

scenarios.explanation: The opening number frames the discussion. An independent estimate moves the negotiation back to value, alternatives and evidence.
missingEvidence: Value of alternatives and switching costs.
A reservation point agreed before the counteroffer.
scenarios.evidenceNote: Anchoring is a plausible risk because the counteroffer is derived from the opening number. The opening number may still contain useful market information.
scenarios.nextAction: Freeze the independent range before reviewing the supplier’s justification.

scenarios.title: The team defends what it already announced
scenarios.prompt: A team publicly announced that it would never accept a contract longer than one year. New evidence shows a longer term could reduce total risk, but every analysis is now used to defend the public position.
scenarios.question: What would make an update legitimate rather than convenient?

options.text: Apply evidence thresholds and review conditions defined before the new offer arrived.
Keep the position because changing it would always show weakness.
Change the position privately without recording why.

scenarios.explanation: A public commitment can shape later evidence use. Predefined update criteria allow change when relevant evidence arrives without silently rewriting the logic.
missingEvidence: Original reasons for the one-year limit.
Future risks and benefits of each contract term.
scenarios.evidenceNote: Confirmation bias may influence the analysis, while reputation and bargaining strategy are also real considerations that should be stated separately.
scenarios.nextAction: Record the evidence threshold for changing the position and test the new offer against it.
